claims.statement: Tom Allen was to spar Joe Coburn in ring costume as the wind-up of a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall.
claims.excerpt: is between Joe Coburn and Tom Allen, who appear in ring costume

notes: Says the exhibition was 'to-morrow night' (26 April). Articles 395 and 396 say it was on Monday night, 25 April; the date conflicts and needs checking.
